tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Invocation at the Dinner Celebrating the Commissioning of the USS Carl M. Levin, by Rabbi Arnold Resnicoff (23 June 2023)

tei:div.tei:head: Invocation at the Dinner Celebrating the Commissioning of the USS Carl M. Levin, by Rabbi Arnold Resnicoff (23 June 2023)

tei:lg.tei:l: Almighty God,
As we break bread, give thanks for food
We recall all those who hunger still:
Not for bread alone,
But for freedom, dignity, respect, and hope.
Carl Levin championed the fight for better times and better lives,
Lives more respected, lives more protected.
We celebrate his life,
the strength, integrity, and moral courage that defined him,
as we prepare for the commissioning tomorrow
of the USS CARL M LEVIN,
our Navy’s — nation’s — newest ship,
whose officers and crew prepare to serve with honor, courage, and commitment
to defend our freedoms and our dreams.
TENACIOUS IN THE FIGHT:
Apt words both for Levin and the proud and mighty ship that bears his name,
Prepared to serve when duty calls.
Prepared to fight — and win — when fight we must.
We celebrate tonight with joy
And the commissioning tomorrow with overwhelming pride.
May the actions of this ship and crew
Bring honor to our Navy and our nation,
Just as the man whose name it bears
Brought honor to us, blessed us all.
And may we say Amen.
